description: This Java class 'SparkplugDeviceSessionContext' manages Sparkplug device sessions within an MQTT transport context, handling device metrics, attribute updates, and RPC requests.

classes.name: SparkplugDeviceSessionContext
classes.description: Manages Sparkplug device session state, including device metrics, attribute updates, and RPC handling within MQTT transport.

methods.name: getDeviceBirthMetrics
methods.description: Returns the map of device birth metrics.

methods.name: setDeviceBirthMetrics
methods.description: Sets the device's birth metrics from a list, validating metric names and aliases.

methods.name: onAttributeUpdate
methods.description: Handles attribute update notifications, processing metrics and publishing relevant MQTT messages.

methods.name: onToDeviceRpcRequest
methods.description: Processes RPC requests directed to the device, constructing and sending appropriate MQTT messages or error responses.
